scope: Isolated fixtures reflecting inspected public merchant shape; no live model, order or financial writes
labels: Uncertain photo offers independently read complete retailer packages without a quote
Selected package uses fresh public PDP price and mandatory shipping, never search/coupon price1
Purchase limit is preserved without inflating photo confidence or applying perfume pricing
Unrecognised brands cannot cause speculative merchant searches
Explicit uncertain family is not replaced with the SKU confidence
Arbitrary client IDs outside stored merchant choices cannot be fetched
Sold-out packages do not retain a previous quoted price
A changed package is rejected rather than silently replacing the chosen size
Unverified shipping terms cannot become an accepted quote
External image URLs cannot replace the verified retailer picture
Minimum two cannot be priced as one purchasable package
A known family with unverified retailer capacity is not a completed package
Cold-chain onward delivery is not assumed by the automatic package flow
Rejected known merchant data cannot fall back to an AI-supplied Kurly price
Unavailable known merchant evidence does not retain an AI-supplied source
Known storage constraints stop the paid second stage and explain seller review
